overview: Memo (1941): British intelligence reports Japanese shipping staff recalled from South America days before Pearl Harbor.

people.name: R. E. Schuirman
people.role: Navy Department official signing by direction of the Chief of Naval Operations

keywords: Office of the Chief of Naval Operations

subfiles.title: Memorandum on recall of Japanese shipping representatives from South America
subfiles.from: Office of the Chief of Naval Operations, Navy Department; signed R. E. Schuirman by direction
subfiles.about: The memorandum reports that Japanese shipping-company representatives in Montevideo and Buenos Aires had been recalled to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Navy relays British intelligence that Japanese shipping-company staff in South America were recalled home just before Pearl Harbor.

interest: Index on a 1941 Japanese shipping-staff recall before Pearl Harbor.
